positive.point: Margin account performance calculations have been fixed, and users are receiving checks for previous errors.
Vanguard's performance graph glitches have been fixed, improving the accuracy of account overviews.
Vanguard's customer service is responsive, with advisors replying even on weekends.

negative.point: Vanguard's performance calculations and UI have several bugs, causing confusion and mistrust among users.
Vanguard's tools for tracking investment performance and diversification are lacking, leading to user frustration.
Vanguard's communication about changes to tools and projections is insufficient, causing concern among users.
Vanguard's Portfolio Watch tool inaccurately measures diversification for 'all-in-one' funds.
